title: RunsOnAnything
description: Built to run on almost everything, with performance optimizations that significantly boost FPS, also improving game experience.
body:
## RunsOnAnything

RunsOnAnything is a lightweight Minecraft modpack built with one clear goal: **make the game run smoothly on almost any device**. It focuses entirely on performance, stability, and low resource usage, without turning Minecraft into something unrecognizable.

This pack is designed for **low-end PCs, older laptops, and systems with limited RAM or weaker CPUs**. Every mod included serves a purpose. There are no heavy content mods, no unnecessary visual effects, and no background features that silently eat performance. The result is faster loading times, smoother chunk rendering, reduced stuttering, and more consistent FPS during normal gameplay.

RunsOnAnything stays close to the vanilla experience. Gameplay mechanics, progression, and balance remain untouched, making the pack ideal for survival worlds, casual play, and long-term saves. You get a cleaner, smoother version of Minecraft—nothing more, nothing less.

Default settings are pre-configured for performance, but advanced users can still tweak options if they want to trade visuals for extra FPS. The pack is tested with low memory allocations and works well even on systems that struggle with standard modpacks.

If you want Minecraft to **just run well**—without crashes, lag spikes, or unnecessary bloat—RunsOnAnything is built for exactly that.


**Recommended Specs:**
Works best on low-end systems with **4–8 GB RAM**, a basic CPU, and integrated graphics. Allocate **2–4 GB RAM** for smooth performance. Higher specs will see even better stability and FPS.
